about:
RDS Wire & Cable, Inc. was founded in 1985 in Gardena, California. The company began as a supplier of wire, cable, and insulation solutions and has remained at the same location on East Gardena Boulevard.

The firm operates as a stocking distributor of electronic and electrical wire, cable, tubing, and sleeving. Its product range spans commercial UL AWM styles, military-specification wires such as MIL-W-16878 and SAE AS22759, coaxial cables, and a variety of heat-shrinkable and PTFE tubings. In addition to stocking, RDS provides value-added processing including etching of fluoropolymer (Teflon) wire and tubing, hot marking of heat-shrink tubing, cutting, stripping, striping, tinning, printing, and high-speed twisting of wire into custom cable assemblies.

Primary customers are in the military, aerospace, and commercial equipment manufacturing sectors. The company supplies materials meeting specifications such as MIL-C-27500, MIL-C-17, MIL-I-22129, and various SAE AS23053 heat-shrink standards, as well as UL-listed appliance wiring materials for industrial equipment builders.

RDS emphasizes low minimum-order quantities and fast order fulfillment, supported by an experienced sales staff and extensive processing and packaging capabilities. Its quality management system has been certified to ISO 9001 and AS9100 since 2003, and the company maintains RoHS, REACH, and conflict-minerals compliance.
